sc: Archaeologist's tools are given to the player by Acting Guildmaster Reiniger during the Archaeology tutorial.

The barrows-dyed augmented Dark Shard of Leng is a level 95 Melee main hand weapon created by using an augmentor on a Dark Shard of Leng (Barrows) or by using a barrows dye on an augmented Dark Shard of Leng.

The blood-dyed augmented malevolent cuirass is level 90 Melee torso slot power armour, created by using an augmentor and divine charges on a malevolent cuirass (blood), or by using blood dye on an augmented malevolent cuirass.

The basic decorative helm is a helmet that can be bought as a reward from Lanthus for 4 silver Castle wars tickets and requires a Defence level of 20 to wear.
Beach Shell Shield is a shield cosmetic override that is obtainable as a rare reward from defeating Clawdia in Sunlight Shores.

A red bird's egg is an item that can be found in bird's nest, which fall from trees while Woodcutting.
The blank observation is an item obtained from Azzanadra.

If lost, it can be re-obtained from Azzanadra, Ariane (next to the entrance to the praetorium war table at the Kharid-et Dig Site), or at May's Quest Caravan (after putting 150 quest points into the Hub Track).
It can be obtained as a Treasure Trail reward or purchased from either another player or from the Grand Exchange.
It cannot be made using the Crafting skill.
The blue shorthair fur token is an unlock token that is a possible reward from Treasure Hunter during the Catwalk: The Sameowrai promotion.
This Book page is found on a crude table at the top floor of Paterdomus during the Legacy of Seergaze quest along with a glove.

They can be purchased at Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock.
A casket (easy) was the item received after completing the final clue scroll of an easy clue scroll trail prior to the Clue Scroll Overhaul on 26 February 2018.
It contained the reward for the easy trails prior to this date.

Crimson skillchompas are a special type of weapon obtained by catching crimson skillchompas in the Desert Quarry Hunter area at level 89 Hunter.
The Crystal (invulnerability) is a type of lava crystal that spawns throughout the Fight Kiln minigame after completing waves 1, 13, and 25.
This is a crystal that is often picked up and used, as it can be very useful in dealing with the first few hits on waves that spawn TokHaar-Jad, as well when there are two TokHaar-Jads on wave 36.
It cannot be crafted from mystic cloth unlike the standard blue variant, and is only available as a drop from aberrant spectres.
It can be created from 3,600 divination fragments with level 80 Divination and 20 Invention.
It could also be obtained from Treasure Hunter on 13 and 15, and 16 November 2015.

The dragonbone full helm is created by using the Dragonbone upgrade kit on a Dragon full helm.
It is obtained by giving alco-chunks to a parrot in the Ardougne Zoo.
He will then turn them into a fake man that the player can give to Burntmeat, a Troll cook, in order to obtain some information about Goutweed.
If you lose the parrot, you can obtain it back by speaking to Eadgar.

sc: Entropic gloves are tier 11 necromancy tank gloves available in Daemonheim.
They are the highest tier necromancy gloves available in Daemonheim and are exclusively dropped by Hobgoblin Geomancer.
Feral Shortbow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the Feral Ranged Weapon Pack.

The main appeal to the rod-o-matic is the cost; it's possible to obtain the materials for a rod-o-matic for under 200,000 coins, which is much lower than the potential 600,000+ price tag of a crystal rod, not including the cost of potential crystal siphons.

This makes the rod-o-matic a cheaper way of training Invention through Fishing, but brings slower Fishing experience as it both does not have the bonus to fishing experience that the crystal rod does, and requires the player to disassemble various items to obtain the components needed to make it.

Jormungand Sword.x: The Jormungand Sword cosmetic override is obtained by handing in 2,000 valkyrie feathers to Eir during the 2019 Winter event.

sc: A blue key is the fourth coloured key available in Melzar's Maze.

It could originally be unlocked through Treasure Hunter; it may also be unlocked from the DXP Token Store for 2,500 Double XP Tokens when purchasing a random unowned piece of Lunarfury equipment.

The Moonstone Gala Attire Jacket is a torso slot cosmetic override that is part of the Moonstone Gala Attire outfit, obtained by redeeming all other Gala Attire outfit tokens.

The item was originally created from 500 lightweight feathers when these were obtainable between 10 March 2016 to 14 March 2016 as an exclusive prize from Treasure Hunter.

Nocturnal High Shaman Gloves.x: The Nocturnal High Shaman Gloves are a hands slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Nocturnal Shaman Bundle.
